title: Statement, Collections, Write-Off and Refund Figures of Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility
content:
The patient-account figures below apply to every coverage account of **Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility**, set by the payer class of the account.

| Payer class | Statement cycle (calendar days) | Statements with an unpaid balance before collections | Collections referral permitted | Smallest balance referable (USD) | Small-balance write-off ceiling (USD) | Automatic refund threshold for a credit (USD) | Refund issued within (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Original Medicare Part B | 30 | 3 | yes | 50.00 | 4.99 | 5.00 | 60 |
| Medicare Advantage HMO | 30 | 3 | yes | 50.00 | 4.99 | 5.00 | 60 |
| Medicare Advantage PPO | 30 | 3 | yes | 50.00 | 4.99 | 5.00 | 60 |
| Medicaid Fee-for-Service | 30 | 3 | no | 50.00 | 4.99 | 5.00 | 60 |
| Commercial HMO | 30 | 3 | yes | 50.00 | 4.99 | 5.00 | 30 |
| Commercial PPO | 30 | 3 | yes | 50.00 | 4.99 | 5.00 | 30 |
| Medicare Supplement Plan G | 30 | 3 | yes | 50.00 | 4.99 | 5.00 | 60 |

## Definitions

- **Statement cycle**: calendar days between consecutive patient statements on an account carrying a balance.
- **Statements before collections**: the number of statements that must have shown an unpaid balance before the account may be referred to collections.
- **Collections referral permitted**: whether an unpaid balance on the class may be referred to an outside collection agency at all.
- **Smallest balance referable**: the smallest unpaid balance that may be referred to collections.
- **Small-balance write-off ceiling**: the largest remaining balance that is written off rather than statemented again after the final statement cycle.
- **Automatic refund threshold**: the smallest credit balance refunded automatically without a patient request; smaller credits are refunded only on request.
- **Refund issued within**: calendar days after a credit balance arises (or after a refund request for a sub-threshold credit) within which the refund must be issued.

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical)

- A remaining balance of 4.99 sits at the write-off ceiling; a balance of 5.00 is above it.
- A credit of 5.00 meets the automatic refund threshold; a credit of 4.99 is below it and is refunded only on request.
- A balance of 49.99 is below the smallest referable balance of 50.00; Medicaid Fee-for-Service accounts are not referable at any balance.
